_help: Hand edits merged over the GitHub API data on every refresh; this file is never overwritten by automation. Key = repository name. Fields: about — replaces the description; lang — replaces the language; demo — demo URL, set "" to show plain text without a link; order — lower number floats higher (default: newest first); hide — true to exclude the repo. New repositories appear automatically with their API description until you add them here.

ansible-ui.about: Web control plane for Ansible and IaC — Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi — with a real-PTY live terminal.

coredns-ui.about: Observability and management console for CoreDNS on Kubernetes — per-query dnstap tracing, Corefile history, diff and doctor.

notes-ui.about: Team link and contact directory — SQLite, WebSocket live sync, Helm chart, Chrome extension.

etcd-ui.about: UI for any etcd cluster — Kubernetes, Patroni, standalone or DIY.

k8s-view.about: Multi-cluster Kubernetes dashboard — live WebSocket streaming, exec, logs, port-forward, YAML edit.

ssl-domain-exporter.about: Monitoring for SSL certificates and domain registration expiry — web UI, REST API, Prometheus metrics.

calico-ui.about: Explorer for Goldmane network flow data from Calico clusters.

mongostudio.about: Blazing-fast MongoDB UI — collections, queries, aggregations, live monitoring.
